tasks.title: LC34：非降序数组中的首次与末次出现位置
tasks.contract: Original LC34: non-decreasing vector<int>, 0<=n<=100000, values and target in [-10^9,10^9]; return zero-based first and last occurrence as array<int,2>, or {-1,-1} when absent. Input is unchanged. Helper lower_bound_manual returns first >=target, upper_bound_manual first >target, each returning n when no such element exists. Reference functions require valid original input and define no policy for unsorted data. Platform adapter returns vector<int>.

methods.title: 分别定位不小于与大于目标的边界
methods.invariant: For each boundary, [0,left) satisfies the left-side comparison and [right,n) satisfies its negation; the first right-side position remains in [left,right]. The occurrence set is the half-open interval [lower,upper); lower==upper means absence.

tasks.title: LC875：在独立整小时限制下求最小速度
tasks.contract: Original LC875: 1<=piles.size()<=10000; each pile in [1,10^9]; piles.size()<=hours<=10^9. One hour serves only one pile and cannot transfer unused time to another pile. Return the minimum positive integer speed; leave piles unchanged. Public checker additionally permits every positive int speed, including INT_MAX on the target platform. Min-speed function requires original legal input; no malformed-input policy.

methods.title: 对逐堆向上整除的可行性寻找首个真值
methods.invariant: H(speed)=sum ceil(pile/speed) is non-increasing; [left,right] contains the least feasible speed and right is feasible. Search starts at [1,max(piles)] because max(piles) consumes one hour per pile and hours>=n.

complexity.time: O(n log(P+1)), P=max(piles), including O(n) bound scan

tasks.title: CSES1620：并行机器达到目标产量的最短时间
tasks.contract: Original CSES1620: 1<=n<=200000, target in [1,10^9], integer machine periods in [1,10^9]; machines run simultaneously from time zero. Return minimum non-negative integer time to produce at least target units as long long; input unchanged. Checker accepts any non-negative long long candidate time and saturates by comparing each machine output with remaining target before addition. Original valid input required for min-time function.

methods.title: 并行产量判定与最快机器的可行上界
methods.invariant: Production sum floor(time/period) is non-decreasing. The unfinished accumulator always stays below target; a machine meeting the remaining deficit proves feasibility immediately. [left,right] contains the earliest feasible time and right is feasible; fastest_period*target is feasible and at most 10^18.

complexity.time: O(n log(m*target+1)), m=min(periods), including O(n) bound scan

tasks.title: CSES1085：恰好k个非空连续段的最小最大段和
tasks.contract: Original CSES1085: 1<=n<=200000, 1<=exact_blocks<=n, positive integer values in [1,10^9]. Partition all elements in original order into exactly k nonempty contiguous subarrays; return the minimum possible maximum subarray sum as long long. Do not modify or sort input. Checker tests at most max_blocks at candidate limit>=0; positive values and k<=n allow splitting multi-element blocks to establish equivalence with exactly k nonempty blocks. Negative/zero input values are outside the taught original contract.

methods.title: 证明最少分段贪心后搜索首个可行和上限
methods.invariant: For a fixed limit, each greedy block is the longest feasible prefix of the remaining suffix; after r blocks it reaches at least as far as any valid r-block partition. Thus greedy uses minimum blocks. If it uses <=k, positivity and k<=n permit splitting to exactly k nonempty blocks. Feasibility is monotone in limit; [max(values),sum(values)] contains optimum and its right endpoint is feasible.
